The '''Aa'kuan Champion's Cave''' was the headquarters of the [[Aa'kuan]]s on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

==History==
{{Quote|A powerful anarchist has subverted our order of philosophical thinkers and has brainwashed them. They all need to be killed to bring back the balance to all things. Go find them and bring to them the gift of balance - with your blaster.|An Aa'kuan champion, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|An Aa'kuan champion|Talus}}</ref>}}
The cave was the center of operations for the Aa'kuan on the planet Talus, in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SWG:ACC" /> The Aa'kuans were anarchists who believed they had the right to govern themselves and that no authority had the right to invade other sentients' individual space, specifically, no government.<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref>

[[File:Aakuan_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Aa'kuan adepts in the cave.]]
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Aa'kuans on Talus split into two factions.<ref name="SWG:AC" /> While the Aa'kuans were mostly non-violent,<ref name="CDAG" /> the Aa'kuans living in the Aa'kuan Champion's Cave started a bloody crusade against all those who refused to believe their doctrine, initiating a conflict with traditional and pacifist Aa'kuans.<ref name="SWG:AC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an adept of the True Aa'kuan Order requested a spacer to kill all the bloodthirsty members of the other Aa'kuan community in order to "bring back the balance to all things".<ref name="SWG:AC" />
